The '''CEO''' of [[Taerab Starship Manufacturing]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], prompting Taerab to refuse to build any more [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] for the Empire.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Professional Courtesy}}</ref>
